title: BANXE AgentDecisionRecord (Decision Lineage)
description: Executable contract for the AgentDecisionRecord emitted by every consequential L2 agent decision (ADR-046 Decision Lineage Schema). Validates the ACTUAL record produced at runtime by the DecisionRecorder (_lineage.py is the field source of truth) — the atomic unit of decision lineage: one consequential decision -> one immutable record, keyed to a client intent and linkable via correlation_id. This schema validates the lineage records of ALL 9 client-facing agents (banxe-payment-core + banxe-emi-stack). RUNTIME-vs-SPEC NOTE: ADR-046 D2 prose marks `immutable_storage_ref` as NOT NULL (required); the code/runtime currently emits it as nullable (default null) because the DecisionRecorder ClickHouse immutable sink is NOT yet live (audit gap #4). This schema deliberately reflects RUNTIME reality (nullable) rather than the ADR target, with a documented path to the ADR-046 D2/D6 target: once the immutable sink is operational (Terminal-A / §D6), `immutable_storage_ref`, `input_tokens`, and `output_tokens` become REQUIRED and non-null and this schema MUST be tightened to match. R-SEC (MANDATORY): NO field of this record may contain secret material (API keys, tokens, credentials, private keys) or raw PII beyond the PII-minimized, regulator-legible summary permitted in `reasoning_summary` per ADR-016 routing. `reasoning_summary` is a durable rationale, NOT raw chain-of-thought and NOT a dump of client personal data.

record_id.description: Primary identity of this decision record (UUID/ULID). Globally unique, immutable, assigned at emit time (ADR-046 D2).

timestamp.description: Instant the decision was finalized by the agent. UTC, RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 date-time, millisecond precision (ADR-046 D2 DateTime64).

agent_id.description: Canonical snake_case id of the deciding L2 agent (e.g. mlro_agent, aml_check_agent, sanctions_check_agent) per .claude/rules/agents.md roster. Same id space as agent_passport.schema.json agent_id.

triggering_event.description: What caused the decision — event type + reference (e.g. inbound payment id, KYC webhook id, intent submission id). Cross-links to the guardian_audit_events / source event (ADR-046 D2). NO secrets/PII (R-SEC).

intent.description: The client intent this decision serves — natural-language intent text or a stable reference to the L1 Intent Layer intent record (ADR-045 L1). Anchors the decision to what the client asked for. PII-minimized (R-SEC / ADR-016).

policies_evaluated.description: Ordered list of policy / rule / invariant identifiers evaluated for this decision (e.g. I-02, R-COMP-FCA-02, sanctions ruleset version, AML scenario ids). MAY be empty []; an empty array means no policy gate was applied, itself an auditable fact (ADR-046 D2).

compliance_result.description: Net compliance outcome of the evaluated policies for this decision (ADR-046 D2).

reasoning_summary.description: Concise, human-legible, regulator-facing summary of WHY the agent decided as it did. PII-minimized per ADR-016. NOT raw chain-of-thought, NOT secret material (R-SEC) — a durable, reviewable rationale.

confidence_score.description: The agent's confidence in the decision, on the HITL threshold scale of .claude/rules/agents.md: AUTO > 0.90 / REVIEW 0.70-0.90 / BLOCK < 0.70. Governs the human_reviewed_by obligation below (see allOf if/then).

action_taken.description: The concrete action the agent took or proposed (e.g. APPROVE_PAYMENT, HOLD_FOR_REVIEW, FILE_SAR, REJECT_KYC) + reference to the executed operation if any (ADR-046 D2).

human_reviewed_by.description: HITL reviewer identity (MLRO / CEO / dublёr) when the decision was paused for REVIEW or BLOCK. NULL for AUTO (confidence > 0.90) decisions that required no human. MUST be non-null whenever confidence_score < 0.90 (REVIEW/BLOCK bands) — enforced by the allOf if/then below (ADR-046 D2 + .claude/rules/agents.md HITL thresholds).

correlation_id.description: Cross-cutting trace id tying this decision to the whole intent->execution->audit chain and to sibling records in the same flow. Same correlation_id family used by guardian_audit_events and the ClickHouse audit trail. Also the key per-window cost aggregation (ADR-047 D5) groups on.

cost_tokens.description: ADR-047 D5 cost attribution (default-present). Total tokens (in+out) consumed by this decision's inference, metered at the LiteLLM gateway (ADR-043). Cost is a first-class lineage field, recorded on the same row, not a parallel store.

cost_amount.description: ADR-047 D5 (default-present). Monetary cost of the decision's inference, as a DECIMAL STRING — never a float (CLAUDE.md money rule). Reporting currency per config-as-data (ADR-047 cost_currency).

budget_window_ref.description: ADR-047 D5 (default-present). Reference to the per-window budget bucket this decision counted against (agent + window id). The per-window cap (ADR-047 D2) and circuit-breaker (D3) evaluate the aggregate keyed by this ref + correlation_id.

budget_breach_flag.description: ADR-047 D5 (default-present). Whether this decision crossed a cap: NONE within budget, WARN within a configured soft band, BREACH over a hard cap (ADR-047 D2) — tied to the circuit-breaker trip (D3). Itself an auditable fact.

immutable_storage_ref.description: ADR-046 D2 tamper-evidence anchor (ClickHouse part+offset / WORM object key / hash-chain anchor per ADR-027 durability). SPEC-vs-RUNTIME: ADR-046 prose marks this REQUIRED/NOT-NULL, but the runtime emits it nullable (default null) because the DecisionRecorder immutable ClickHouse sink is NOT yet live (audit gap #4). This schema reflects runtime reality. WHEN THE SINK LANDS (ADR-046 §D6 / Terminal-A): this becomes REQUIRED and non-null — tighten this schema then.

input_tokens.description: ADR-046 §D5 additive (currently OPTIONAL, nullable, default null). Input/prompt tokens consumed (ADR-047 cost_tokens_input). Becomes REQUIRED and non-null once the cost-metering sink is operational (ADR-046 §D6 / Terminal-A).

output_tokens.description: ADR-046 §D5 additive (currently OPTIONAL, nullable, default null). Output/completion tokens generated (ADR-047 cost_tokens_output). Becomes REQUIRED and non-null once the cost-metering sink is operational (ADR-046 §D6 / Terminal-A).

allOf.$comment: ADR-046 D2 + HITL thresholds: a decision below the AUTO band (confidence_score < 0.90, i.e. REVIEW 0.70-0.90 or BLOCK < 0.70) MUST carry a non-null, non-empty human_reviewed_by.
